people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.
translations.bsb: and he said to his relatives, “Gather some stones.” So they took stones and made a mound, and there by the mound they ate.
translations.kjv: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made an heap: and they did eat there upon the heap.
translations.asv: And Jacob said unto his brethren, Gather stones; and they took stones, and made a heap: and they did eat there by the heap.
